# Домашно

> Class timetable + homework board for a school class. The app itself needs
> sign-in, but /terms and /privacy are public.

Домашно (Domashno) lets a class import its weekly timetable from a Shkolo PDF
and post homework with text and file attachments (photos, PDF, presentations).
It installs as a PWA, works in Bulgarian and English, and has light/dark themes.

- [Terms of Service](/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy)
- [Source code](https://github.com/gaxolotl/domashno)
- [Admin panel](/admin) (restricted to the instance administrator)
- API: same-origin JSON under [/api](/api) (authentication required)
